In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]] '''rescued''' [[Chi Eekway Papanoida/Legends|Chi Eekway Papanoida]] from aboard a [[Unidentified Lucrehulk-class battleship (Pantora)/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]] that the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] was using to [[Blockade of Pantora/Legends|blockade]] [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]].
